授業概要
本講義は池谷教授が担当する．流体力学の基礎方程式とその数値流体解析方法までを講義する．学部教育で流体力学を受講していない学生や，流体力学を学んでいるが数値解析手法を学習したい学生を対象とする．以上により，数値流体解析（Computational Fluid dynamics; CFD）手法を習得する．
詳細は初回講義で説明します．教材はMoodleで共有しますので，事前登録をお願いします．講義は英語です（日本人学生には日本でサポートもできますが，留学生の受講が多いため講義は英語です）．演習用のプログラムを使った実践的な講義をしますので，ノートパソコンを持参してください．プログラム言語はPythonを使います．事前に環境構築をしておくと受講がスムーズです．
This lecture is conducted by Prof. Ikegaya. The lecture covers i) fundamental governing equations for fluid flows, and ii) numerical simulation methods to solve these equations. The contents of the lecture are suitable for both students who do not learn fundamental fluid dynamics as well as advanced learners of fluid dynamics because the lecture covers fundamental simulation techniques solving the equations. You can learn details of the computation fluid dynamics techniques.
The details of the lecture will be explained in the first class. Materials and information will be shared via Moodel. Please register in advance. During lectures, sample exercise programs are distributed, and students are requested to try coding and debuting by trials and errors. So, please bring your own laptop computer. The computer language used in the course is Python. I recommend building the environment in advance so that you can smoothly start the exercise. The lecture will be delivered in English.

全体の教育目標
The aim of this lecture is following three aspects: i) reviewing the fundamental knowledge on fluid mechanics and ii) learning numerical simulation methods solving the governing equations of fluid flows.
